title: Change Simple Past into Past Progressive

explanation.tr:
Simple Past cümlesini Past Progressive'e çevir:
• Simple Past: She cooked dinner. (Yaptı, bitti.)
• Past Progressive: She was cooking dinner. (Yapıyordu, süreç.)
Adımlar:
1. Özneye göre was/were seç: I/he/she/it → was, you/we/they → were
2. Ana fiili yalın hâle getir ve -ing ekle: cooked → cooking, ran → running, wrote → writing
Olumsuz: didn't play → wasn't playing; Soru: Did they play? → Were they playing?
explanation.tk:
Simple Past sözlemini Past Progressive-e öwür:
• Simple Past: She cooked dinner. (Etdi, gutardy.)
• Past Progressive: She was cooking dinner. (Edýärdi, proses.)
Ädimler:
1. Eýä görä was/were saýla: I/he/she/it → was, you/we/they → were
2. Esasy işligi esasy görnüşe getirip -ing goş: cooked → cooking, ran → running, wrote → writing
Ýokluk: didn't play → wasn't playing; Sorag: Did they play? → Were they playing?
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй Simple Past в Past Progressive:
• Simple Past: She cooked dinner. (Приготовила, закончено.)
• Past Progressive: She was cooking dinner. (Готовила, процесс.)
Шаги:
1. Выбери was/were по подлежащему: I/he/she/it → was, you/we/they → were
2. Верни глагол в начальную форму и добавь -ing: cooked → cooking, ran → running, wrote → writing
Отрицание: didn't play → wasn't playing; Вопрос: Did they play? → Were they playing?

examples.en: She cooked dinner. → She was cooking dinner.
They played chess. → They were playing chess.
I wrote a letter. → I was writing a letter.
He ran in the park. → He was running in the park.
We didn't sleep. → We weren't sleeping.
Did you study? → Were you studying?

title: Change Simple Present into Present Perfect

explanation.tr:
Simple Present cümlesini Present Perfect'e çevir:
• Simple Present: She visits her aunt. (Genelde ziyaret eder.)
• Present Perfect: She has visited her aunt. (Ziyaret etti, sonuç şimdi.)
Adımlar:
1. have/has seç: I/you/we/they → have, he/she/it → has
2. Fiili V3 yap: visit → visited, see → seen, write → written, go → gone
Olumsuz: doesn't eat → hasn't eaten; Soru: Do you know? → Have you known?
explanation.tk:
Simple Present sözlemini Present Perfect-e öwür:
• Simple Present: She visits her aunt. (Adatça baryp görýär.)
• Present Perfect: She has visited her aunt. (Baryp gördi, netije häzir.)
Ädimler:
1. have/has saýla: I/you/we/they → have, he/she/it → has
2. Işligi V3 et: visit → visited, see → seen, write → written, go → gone
Ýokluk: doesn't eat → hasn't eaten; Sorag: Do you know? → Have you known?
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй Simple Present в Present Perfect:
• Simple Present: She visits her aunt. (Обычно навещает.)
• Present Perfect: She has visited her aunt. (Навестила, результат сейчас.)
Шаги:
1. Выбери have/has: I/you/we/they → have, he/she/it → has
2. Поставь глагол в V3: visit → visited, see → seen, write → written, go → gone
Отрицание: doesn't eat → hasn't eaten; Вопрос: Do you know? → Have you known?

examples.en: She visits her aunt. → She has visited her aunt.
I write an email. → I have written an email.
They go home. → They have gone home.
He doesn't eat. → He hasn't eaten.
Do you see it? → Have you seen it?
We buy a car. → We have bought a car.

topic: Tenses – Shifted: Present Progressive → Simple Present
title: Change Present Progressive into Simple Present

explanation.tr:
Present Progressive (şu an) cümlesini Simple Present'e (genelde) çevir:
• She is reading. → She reads.
• They are playing. → They play.
Adımlar:
1. am/is/are'yı kaldır.
2. -ing'i kaldır, fiili yalın yap.
3. he/she/it ise -s/-es ekle: is watching → watches, is studying → studies
I am running → I run (I ile -s yok).
explanation.tk:
Present Progressive (häzir) sözlemini Simple Present-e (adatça) öwür:
• She is reading. → She reads.
• They are playing. → They play.
Ädimler:
1. am/is/are-ny aýyr.
2. -ing-i aýyryp, işligi esasy görnüşe getir.
3. he/she/it bolsa -s/-es goş: is watching → watches, is studying → studies
I am running → I run (I bilen -s ýok).
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй Present Progressive (сейчас) в Simple Present (обычно):
• She is reading. → She reads.
• They are playing. → They play.
Шаги:
1. Убери am/is/are.
2. Убери -ing, верни начальную форму.
3. Для he/she/it добавь -s/-es: is watching → watches, is studying → studies
I am running → I run (с I без -s).

examples.en: She is reading. → She reads.
They are playing. → They play.
He is watching TV. → He watches TV.
I am running. → I run.
My sister is studying. → My sister studies.
We are going to school. → We go to school.

topic: Tenses – Shifted: Present Progressive → Simple Present – Negation
title: Negatives: Present Progressive → Simple Present

explanation.tr:
Olumsuz Present Progressive cümlesini olumsuz Simple Present'e çevir:
• I'm not working. → I don't work.
• She isn't working. → She doesn't work.
• They aren't working. → They don't work.
Kural: am not / aren't → don't; isn't → doesn't. Fiil yalın kalır (doesn't works ✗).
explanation.tk:
Ýokluk Present Progressive sözlemini ýokluk Simple Present-e öwür:
• I'm not working. → I don't work.
• She isn't working. → She doesn't work.
• They aren't working. → They don't work.
Düzgün: am not / aren't → don't; isn't → doesn't. Işlik esasy görnüşde galýar (doesn't works ✗).
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй отрицание из Present Progressive в Simple Present:
• I'm not working. → I don't work.
• She isn't working. → She doesn't work.
• They aren't working. → They don't work.
Правило: am not / aren't → don't; isn't → doesn't. Глагол в начальной форме (doesn't works ✗).

examples.en: I'm not working. → I don't work.
She isn't singing. → She doesn't sing.
They aren't swimming. → They don't swim.
He isn't watching TV. → He doesn't watch TV.
We aren't cooking. → We don't cook.

topic: Tenses – Shifted: Present Progressive → Simple Present – Questions
title: Questions: Present Progressive → Simple Present

explanation.tr:
Present Progressive sorusunu Simple Present sorusuna çevir:
• Are you working? → Do you work?
• Is she working? → Does she work?
• What are they eating? → What do they eat?
Kural: Am/Are → Do; Is → Does. -ing kalkar, fiil yalın olur.
explanation.tk:
Present Progressive soragyny Simple Present soragyna öwür:
• Are you working? → Do you work?
• Is she working? → Does she work?
• What are they eating? → What do they eat?
Düzgün: Am/Are → Do; Is → Does. -ing aýrylýar, işlik esasy görnüşe geçýär.
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй вопрос из Present Progressive в Simple Present:
• Are you working? → Do you work?
• Is she working? → Does she work?
• What are they eating? → What do they eat?
Правило: Am/Are → Do; Is → Does. -ing убирается, глагол в начальной форме.

Is she singing? → Does she sing?
